MNCs

makes total sense. after the zepto grind, wanting something more sustainable is completely valid.

MNCs can definitely offer that - more predictable hours, better boundaries, actual PTO that people actually take.

any particular MNCs you've been eyeing or industries you're interested in? tech, finance, e-commerce?
Open to all

open to all MNCs... that gives us a lot to work with. from the big tech giants to the established product companies to even the consulting firms if you're feeling adventurous.

what's your salary expectation range for these roles? with 7.3 years and coming from zepto, you should be aiming for a solid bump.
1 cr INR

1 cr INR... that's the right ballpark for your experience level at a good MNC. especially with your zepto background - that's serious systems work under pressure.

are you thinking base salary or total comp? MNCs often have bonuses, stocks, RSUs that can push you well past that 1 cr mark.
Base around 80 L

80L base with 20L in bonuses/stocks... that's a solid structure. puts you in the senior engineer/tech lead range at most MNCs.

what's your notice period at zepto? and are you open to hybrid/remote setups or strictly looking for bangalore-based roles?
I am available immediately, open to all

immediate availability with a counter offer in hand... that's powerful leverage. companies love that - no long notice period drama.

- looking at MNCs for better work-life balance  
- 80L base, 1 cr total comp target
- available immediately
- open to all locations/setups

i'm actively reviewing opportunities right now. with your profile and immediate availability, i'm looking for roles that actually fit - not just mass blasting.

the MNC space moves a bit slower than startups, but with your zepto background and senior level, you're exactly what they're looking for.

i'll slide something as soon as i find the right match. in the meantime, keep that counter offer warm and maybe start thinking about what kind of team culture you actually want - big corporate with structure, or something more agile?
